high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously captures the experience of discovering a song you've always skipped in an album. The text at the top reads: "me accidentally listening to the one song in the album i always skip and realizing it's actually fire." The meme consists of two side-by-side images of a young man with curly hair, wearing a blue and black hoodie. In the left image, he appears to be in a classroom or lecture setting, sitting next to a woman who is looking at her phone. He looks somewhat bored or disinterested, with his mouth slightly open.
